svg.desc: Edit the TEXT layer. Replace the ART layer with art generated from PP-IMG-THUMB-001/002, or keep the drawn art. Show the GUIDES layer while editing; it is hidden for export. Fonts: Space Grotesk 700, Inter 400, JetBrains Mono 500 (30_ASSETS/fonts). The wordmark is linked from 30_ASSETS/brand — keep the folder structure or embed on export.
